timing.measurement_limit: Starts at first recorded clock reading, not task dispatch; excludes later validation.

underlying_raw_source.basis: Frozen projection and source README; no raw source or network access in this review.

semantic_boundary: The complete original title must explicitly identify nonproperty veterinary qualification, occupational training or qualification assessment intent. Veterinary clinic premises, business-property demand, actual care services, and licensing or recognition guidance remain protected. No shortened forms, token peers or inferred abbreviation expansions are proposed.
limits: Semantic proposal only; no admission, approval, deployability or platform-acceptance finding.
Published Ofqual qualification titles are not observed searches, volume, CPC, competition or demand.
Frozen Available to learners status is not fresh course availability, UAE recognition, licensing, eligibility or provider affiliation.
No current-library, archive, protected-query wording or broader-concept membership check was performed.
Provider prefixes, old/new routes, SA/EQ, BVRA, VTEC and non-VTEC peers remain subject to alias, variant, matching-equivalence and distinctness checks.
No campaign, page URL, live identifier or exclusion scope is selected; advertising remains paused.
Text compatibility and length/word holds are preserved separately; no original title is erased, repaired, stripped or shortened.
No new network request, raw-source reconstruction, current-library rebuild, UI work or production mutation was performed.
